facts.statement: Macrocollum was discovered in 2012 at the Wachholz site in Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil.
facts.quote: Macrocollum was discovered in 2012 in Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, at the Wachholz site of the Candelária Formation, Paraná Basin.

facts.statement: The discovery of Macrocollum was announced in a press conference on November 21, 2018.
facts.quote: It was announced in a press conference on November 21, 2018.

facts.statement: The genus name Macrocollum refers to the animal's elongated neck.
facts.quote: The generic name combines the Greek word μακρός (long) and the Latin word collum (neck), referring to the animal's elongated neck.

facts.statement: The species name itaquii honors José Jerundino Machado Itaqui for his role in creating CAPPA/UFSM.
facts.quote: The specific epithet honours José Jerundino Machado Itaqui, one of the main persons behind the creation of CAPPA/UFSM.

facts.statement: Macrocollum was a relatively small, bipedal dinosaur.
facts.quote: Like most early dinosaurs, Macrocollum was relatively small, and walked on two legs.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen of Macrocollum is an almost complete and articulated skeleton.
facts.quote: The holotype specimen consists of an almost complete and articulated skeleton.

facts.statement: Macrocollum holds the record for being the oldest known dinosaur with evidence of an air sac system.
facts.quote: Evidence for an air sac system has been documented in the fossils, and is the oldest known dinosaur with this trait.

facts.statement: Macrocollum is distinguished from other sauropodomorphs by unique skull features, including a promaxillary fenestra in the antorbital fossa and a smooth curve in the supratemporal fossa margin.
facts.quote: Macrocollum itaquii differs from all other known sauropodomorphs based on a unique combination of characters such as those found on the skull, which include an antorbital fossa perforated by a promaxillary fenestra, and a medial margin of the supratemporal fossa with a simple smooth curve at the frontal/parietal suture.

facts.statement: Macrocollum measured approximately 3.5 meters in length, 1.5 meters in height, and weighed around 101.6 kilograms.
facts.quote: Media solo 3,5 metros de largo, 1,5 de alto y pesaba alrededor de 101.6 kilogramos.

facts.statement: Macrocollum is considered one of the oldest known dinosaurs.
facts.quote: It is one of the oldest dinosaurs known.

facts.statement: Macrocollum lived between approximately 225.42 and 225 million years ago during the Norian age of the Late Triassic.
facts.quote: Macrocollum lived between about 225.42 to 225 million years ago, in the Norian age of the late Triassic period.

facts.statement: Macrocollum lived in southern Brazil, which was connected to northwest Africa during the Late Triassic.
facts.quote: It was found in the south of Brazil, which at the time was connected to northwest Africa.

facts.statement: When Macrocollum lived, most of Earth's landmass was united in the supercontinent Pangaea, which was beginning to split into Laurasia and Gondwana.
facts.quote: En ese momento, la mayor parte de la masa terrestre de la Tierra estaba unida en el supercontinente Pangea, que estaba empezando a dividirse en Laurasia en el norte, y Gondwana en el sur.

facts.statement: Macrocollum belongs to the clade Unaysauridae, alongside Jaklapallisaurus and Unaysaurus.
facts.quote: Macrocollum, alongside Jaklapallisaurus and Unaysaurus, was found to belong to the clade Unaysauridae.

facts.statement: Macrocollum is classified within the Unaysauridae clade.
facts.quote: Macrocollum, junto con Jaklapallisaurus y Unaysaurus, se encontró que pertenecía al clado Unaysauridae.

facts.statement: The parent group of Macrocollum is the family Unaysauridae.
facts.quote: Parent group: Unaysauridae

facts.statement: Macrocollum is classified as a member of the order Dinosauria.
facts.quote: superordo: Dinosauria

facts.statement: Macrocollum belongs to the suborder Sauropodomorpha.
facts.quote: subordo: Sauropodomorpha

facts.statement: The ilia of one paratype specimen (CAPPA/UFSM 0001b) were used as a model to study sedimentary compression effects on early sauropodomorph iliac morphology.
facts.quote: Los iliones de uno de los paratipos de Macrocollum, CAPPA/UFSM 0001b, se utilizaron como modelo en un estudio sobre los efectos tafonómicos de la compresión sedimentaria en la morfología ilíaca de los primeros sauropodomorfos.

facts.statement: The genus Macrocollum was described by Müller et al. in 2018.
facts.quote: parent_authority: Müller et al., 2018

facts.statement: The only known species of Macrocollum is M. itaquii.
facts.quote: taxon: Macrocollum itaquii

facts.statement: The authority for the genus Macrocollum is Müller et al., 2018.
facts.quote: genus_authority: Müller et al., 2018

facts.statement: The authority for the species M. itaquii is Müller et al., 2018.
facts.quote: species_authority: Müller et al., 2018

facts.statement: There are two recorded fossil occurrences of Macrocollum.
facts.quote: Fossil occurrences recorded: 2

facts.statement: A study describing the axial skeleton and affinities of Macrocollum itaquii was published by Fonseca et al. in 2026.
facts.quote: Description of the anatomy of the axial skeleton and a study on the affinities of Macrocollum itaquii is published by Fonseca et al. (2026).
